title: Tell HN: Gemini trains on chat history, even for subscribers (personal accounts)
author: jameslk
description: If you have a personal Google AI subscription, all your saved chat history in Gemini can be used for training and there is no way to opt out unless you turn off chat history or use temporary chat sessions. These chat transcripts may even be read by human reviewers. Although Google claims to disconnect them from your…
